subject: STABLE: ASTC app-snapshot fix + MSAA pass sample count; HEAVY RELEASE; analysis of MRT/rdtgt/passes
body: Gates green (run_host_tests 56 PASS up to the known probe step, integration 1005 with only the known CA stride check, render harness, CA test PF0/PF1). Files: c4164868 metal/tegu/build_compute_bundle.py; 352edebf tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh; 81341664 metal/nord2_render_pass.inc; 57ff2c67 build/tegu-frontend/tegu-air-profile.h;  The profile change alters every pipeline-cache key (packs/disk caches refill once). Analysis for (2)-(4), from the c6k log: 'mrt' break = sidecar count>1 OR msaa (compositor_submit tegu_jm_batch_draw_reason). True-MRT jobs (pipelines writing >=2 attachments) are single-draw CLEAR passes by construction (encoder refuses a second true-MRT draw per pass; n2c_mrt_prepare refuses LOAD for MRT), so batching them saves no job; the reducible part would be MSAA (sc->msaa) single-target passes. I cannot split the two from the log -> request to encode-cpu-opus: count mrt vs msaa as separate break names (msaa) and add per-pass shape counters (attachments, load/store per attachment, draws per pass, clear-only passes) to TEGU_PERF_BATCH so the next run tells which passes to merge. rdtgt in the TF1 phase is still ~15% of draws (2329/15507): those are memory-fetch or target-as-texture draws the tile path does not cover (tile variant needs a non-true-MRT pipeline whose input attachment is its own rt); also needs a reason split (fetch-memory vs target-texture) to act on. Next I am taking root's P6/0096 item (GPU-only allocations, IOSurface CPU-access audit, stale-cache fake kernel).
